by
  intro N hN
  have hex : ∃ m : ℕ, 2 * N ≤ m * (m + 1) := ⟨2 * N, by nlinarith⟩
  obtain ⟨j, hj1, hj2⟩ : ∃ j : ℕ, j * (j + 1) < 2 * N ∧ 2 * N ≤ (j + 1) * (j + 1 + 1) := by
    classical
    have spec := Nat.find_spec hex
    have hne : Nat.find hex ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      rw [h0] at spec
      omega
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hne
    have hmin : ¬ 2 * N ≤ j * (j + 1) := Nat.find_min hex (by omega)
    rw [hj] at spec
    exact ⟨j, by omega, spec⟩
  refine ⟨j + 1, ⟨by omega, ?_, hj2⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel, mul_comm]
    exact hj1
  · rintro y ⟨hy, h3, h4⟩
    obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ : ∃ z, y = z + 1 := ⟨y - 1, by omega⟩
    rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel, mul_comm] at h3
    rcases lt_trichotomy z j with hlt | heq | hgt
    · have h5 : (z + 1) * (z + 1 + 1) ≤ j * (j + 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul (by omega) (by omega)
      omega
    · rw [heq]
    · have h5 : (j + 1) * (j + 1 + 1) ≤ z * (z + 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul (by omega) (by omega)
      omega
